name: Knowledge Core (smoke)
description: Small original smoke suite for general factual knowledge. Answers are graded by normalized term containment, so wording may vary as long as the expected fact appears.
provenance: Hand-written by the FSOCIETY AI maintainers for internal smoke testing. This is NOT MMLU, ARC, TriviaQA or any other official benchmark, and no items were copied from a benchmark dataset. The suite exists to catch obvious regressions in factual recall under controlled prompt formatting.
limitations: Twelve items only: scores are indicative, not statistically representative.
Term containment rewards mentions even inside a partially wrong answer.
Facts were selected for stability but may become outdated.
Prompt wording can materially change model accuracy; compare only identical suite versions.

items.prompt: Answer with the chemical symbol only. What is the chemical symbol for gold?
Answer in one short sentence. What is the capital city of Australia?
Answer with the name only. Who wrote the novel Pride and Prejudice?
Answer with the planet name only. Which planet in the Solar System is the largest by mass?
Answer in one short sentence. What is the official currency of Japan?
Answer with the full name only. Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
Answer with the organ name only. Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
Answer with the ocean name only. Which ocean is the largest by surface area?
Answer in one short sentence. What does the abbreviation CPU stand for?
Answer with the chemical formula only. What is the chemical formula of water?
Answer with the language name only. Which language has the most native speakers worldwide?
Answer with the number only. At standard sea-level pressure, what is the boiling point of water in degrees Celsius?
